settings: research_v3.config.V3_DEFAULT (^IRX cash yield, cost 5 bps + slippage 5 bps per side)
trend_filter: price above trend SMA (research_v2 strict >), weekly K-week SMA, unchanged
cap_rule: at most 1 selected asset per group; walk the v2-ranked (momentum desc, universe tie-break) trend-passing assets in order and skip an asset whose group already has a selection

slot_modes.renorm: v2 convention: equal weight over selected assets, 100% CASH only if none qualifies
slot_modes.cashslot: no renormalisation: each of top_n slots is 1/top_n; unfilled slots go to CASH
slot_modes.def: like cashslot, but each unfilled slot goes to IEF if the IEF defensive test passes, else CASH; if IEF is already a risky selection its extra slot weight adds to it

defensive_test.description: IEF adj_close total return from anchor session (latest session <= signal_close - DateOffset(months=3), as v2 find_anchor_session) to the signal close session, WITHOUT the one-week skip (window ends at signal close), strictly greater than the T-bill return over the same window (product of research_v3 CashYieldCurve.accrual_factor over consecutive sessions in (anchor, signal_close], each using the IRX value of the previous session or earlier). IEF if strictly greater, else CASH. Any missing input gives CASH.

ivol_in_candidates: weights proportional to 1/sigma over the risky selected assets only (sigma = sample std ddof=1 of daily adj_close log returns, last ivol_window returns ending at signal close); the risky total (k/top_n under cashslot/def, 1 under renorm) is unchanged; defensive slots keep 1/top_n each

CASHSLOT.description: no renormalisation, unfilled slots to CASH

DEF.description: CASHSLOT with defensive IEF/CASH slot filling

CAND.description: POST-HOC CANDIDATE chosen after seeing step-2 results: ENS (3/6/12 mean momentum) + IVOL (63-session inverse-vol), weekly only, BASE renormalisation

CAND_CAP_DEF.description: POST-HOC CANDIDATE chosen after seeing step-2 results: CAND selection with CAP and DEF slot filling, IVOL on risky share only, weekly only

calendar_year_convention: year return = NAV(last session of year)/NAV(last session of previous year)-1, first year of a partition measured from initial NAV; worst calendar year only over years with at least 200 scored sessions; 2008 reported for train only
